title: Avoid double-wrapping polymorphism trampoline for model serializers
answers: Why are model serializers double-wrapped with polymorphism trampoline?
How to avoid double-wrapping polymorphism trampoline for model serializers?
Where is maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline called in CombinedSerializer?
body:
Symptom: Double-wrapping of the polymorphism trampoline for model serializers.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/shared.rs:CombinedSerializer wrapped the result of find_serializer in maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline.
Fix pattern: Return find_serializer directly without wrapping in maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline.
Constraints: Applies to CombinedSerializer resolution where underlying serializers already manage their own polymorphism trampoline wrapping.
